items.summary: Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and advance two reversible actions: add internal links on eastcoastrappers.com and prepare two consent-aware Reddit drafts for saveusfarms.com. The third eligible candidate is deferred because other candidates already have active work. Smallest next step: complete these actions and record outcomes. Owner decision: keep SearchWoot private, authorize bounded beta after gates, or defer a decision?
